read_order.extract: scoped styles (Vue <style scoped>), CSS modules, Tailwind classes, plain CSS
every component in the page tree, including component-library ones and their theme
custom theme (colors, spacing, fonts, shadows, radius), if the project uses Tailwind

image_inventory.instruction: List every image, screenshot, or visual asset referenced by the page. Include src paths, alt text, and dimensions. These MUST be carried into Paper - never approximate an image with a gradient placeholder.
sources: src attributes and framework image components
Static asset directory files referenced by the page
image_inventory.output: Produce a table: path | alt | width x height | usage context

running_page.instruction: The build reads the page as the browser renders it, so it needs the page running. Use a dev server that is already running. If none is, start one only inside a git worktree or after the user says so. If the page needs sign-in, use the project's local auth bypass or ask the user to sign in in the browser.
running_page.blocker: If the page cannot run, say so and stop. Do not reconstruct from source code alone.

reference_screenshot.instruction: Before building anything in Paper, capture a full-page screenshot of the running page at the artboard width. This is the GROUND TRUTH. Every Paper write_html call must be validated against this screenshot, not against your mental model of the code.
reference_screenshot.method: Playwright MCP: browser_resize to the artboard width, browser_navigate, wait for data to load, browser_take_screenshot with fullPage. Save the path for the verify step.
reference_screenshot.fallback: If no browser tool is available, ask the user to screenshot the page and provide the path.

rendered_dom.instruction: Read the DOM from the browser after the app has rendered and its data has loaded. Plain HTTP fetches return an empty shell for client-rendered apps (Vite, Vue and React SPAs) and miss runtime-injected component-library styles, so they are not a valid source.
rendered_dom.method: With the page open in Playwright, use browser_evaluate to read document.querySelector(target).outerHTML and to run the computed-style walk described in build.json dom_extraction. Save the output to a temp file and record the path for the build step.

svg_extraction.instruction: Trace every icon to its actual SVG source. Never approximate.

sources.icon_libraries: canonical SVG path from the icon name (Lucide, Feather, PrimeIcons, Bootstrap Icons and the like)
sources.icon_components: read the component, or take the rendered <svg> from the browser
sources.icon_fonts: map the glyph to the library's SVG; an icon font glyph is not editable in Paper
